name: Clown Formula
description: Four ingredients and a method, copied in the Hermit's hand. The Club sells these at cost and still makes a profit on what you must buy to fill them.

name: Clown Potion
description: Brewed to the formula by the Club's own hand. Drinking it is the easy part.

name: Magician Formula
description: The next rung, written out. The Star will not sell it to a Sequence 9.

name: Magician Potion
description: Heavier than it looks, and colder than the room.

name: Faceless Formula
description: Three of its four ingredients are ordinary. The fourth is a name, freely given.

name: Faceless Potion
description: The Star hands it over without looking at you, which is not like her.

name: Warding Chalk
description: A stick of consecrated chalk. Draw the circle before you drink, every time, no matter how late it is.

name: Stopped Pocket-Watch
description: A gentleman's watch, stopped at four minutes past nine. It is warm, and it has been in an evidence bag for two days.

name: Halloway's Ledger
description: Thirty-one years of a man's careful hand, and eleven days in somebody else's.

name: Mourning Ring
description: Jet and braided hair, unclaimed since the spring. The Club will take it off your hands and ask nothing.

name: Shop Keys
description: Constable Rell's ring of keys for the Halloway premises, lent for the afternoon and not one minute past it.
